usedFor: 99 Acres holds your property leads, and HubSpot receives each as a contact when “New Leads” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in 99 Acres, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A fresh property lead becomes a HubSpot contact your sales team can work right away.

watchOut: “Create Contact” in HubSpot requires an email, so make sure each 99 Acres lead arrives with one.
